title: 界面底板 · 卷轴
note: 纸色内容区、青绿卷边与简练金饰，保持留白
spec: A BLANK wide rectangular UI scroll panel graphic, redesigning the target using the real game's task-scroll material language. Replace this with a large warm pale parchment content area, restrained dark-teal and blue-green rolled/wooden scroll ends at left and right, a simple slender warm-gold trim, just a few broad graphic cloud curls at corners. title: 功能插画 · 炼丹炉
note: 保留三足双耳炉身份，图形化轮廓与简洁材质
spec: ONE complete Chinese alchemy tripod furnace, isolated asset. Preserve target's jade-green bronze cauldron, round squat body, two square curled upward side handles, three short feet, domed lid and small finial. Reduce the target's intricate beast masks, all-over cloud filigree, patina mottling, carved curls and gold tracery to one clear stylized central cloud/flame emblem and a few plain bands. title: 功能插画 · 灵田
note: 植物成簇、土壤简化，使用原作灵田的图形化语言
spec: ONE small raised spirit herb bed illustration with a watering jug, isolated UI vignette. Preserve target's low rectangular warm-ivory stone planter in three-quarter view, grouped green herbs, ONE small purple flower at left, a taller seed-spike herb at centre, a few red berries at right, and pale celadon watering jug at lower right. The real game's garden screenshot supplies ONLY the simple graphic leaf silhouettes, quiet jade/teal/ochre palette and economical game-UI drawing language. Do NOT turn the asset into a UI screen or add slot grids. Redraw target into much fewer coherent leaf clusters, broad flat plant colours, one restrained shadow tone, very simple soil, three or four large stone blocks with no cracks/engraving or mottled texture, one simple cloud mark at most on jug. No stippled dirt, dense leaf veins, shiny realistic fruit or ornate porcelain pattern. Clearly 2D, clear dark outline and minimal cel shading. Transparent background, no backdrop, UI, text, tutorial arrows or watermark. Square composition, entire bed and jug safely inside.
